resources.title: Full Security-Scan GitHub Actions Workflow
resources.description: A complete security-scan.yml wiring every Chapter 4-5 scan together: SAST via CodeQL, secrets detection via gitleaks, dependency review/OSV-Scanner for SCA, Checkov for IaC scanning, then a build-scan-image job gated behind all four with needs: that runs Trivy image scanning and generates a CycloneDX SBOM via Syft before pushing, and finally a deploy-production job using a GitHub Environment so the required-reviewer protection rule from Lesson 22 actually applies.

resources.title: DevSecOps Pipeline Security Checklist
resources.description: A chapter-by-chapter checklist grounded in this course's own Northbridge Retail checkout pipeline -- least privilege and workload identity, no hardcoded secrets, every Chapter 4 scan running and triaged, image/pipeline hardening, required-reviewer production gates, and the five-stage vulnerability management process from Lesson 27 -- meant to be run on any new service onboarded onto this pipeline pattern and re-run quarterly.

resources.title: OWASP Dependency-Check Suppression File
resources.description: A real dependency-check-suppressions.xml with three documented suppression patterns: a transitive-CVE suppression with a reviewed reason and an expiration date (mirroring Lesson 16's logging-library scenario), a CPE false-positive correction, and a dev-only-dependency suppression by specific vulnerability ID -- every entry showing the triage reasoning Lesson 27 requires instead of a blanket silence rule.
